## Dimensions

---


[Entity Condition Type](https://apugli.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types/entity_condition_types/dimensions).

Compares the entity's dimensions to a specified value.

Type ID: `apugli:dimensions`

---

### Example
```json
{
    "entity_condition": {
        "type": "apugli:dimensions"
    }
}
```

## Dimensions

---


[Entity Condition Type](https://apugli.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types/entity_condition_types/dimensions).

Compares the entity's dimensions to a specified value.

Type ID: `apugli:dimensions`

---

### Example
```json
{
    "entity_condition": {
        "type": "apugli:dimensions"
    }
}
```

dimensions.description: Determines which axes should be checked for the hitbox. Accepts `"width"`, `"height"` or both.
dimensions.markdownDescription: Determines which axes should be checked for the hitbox. Accepts `"width"`, `"height"` or both.

comparison.description: Determines how the entity's dimensions should be compared to the specified value.
comparison.markdownDescription: Determines how the entity's dimensions should be compared to the specified value.

compare_to.description: The value at which the entity's dimensions will be compared to.
compare_to.markdownDescription: The value at which the entity's dimensions will be compared to.
